finding: Upstream fla-core==0.6.0 executes 10-bit mantissa TF32 MMA inside Triton tl.dot on Ampere/Hopper (sm >= 80) even when given torch.float32 inputs: both via Triton default input_precision='tf32' and hardcoded SOLVE_TRIL_DOT_PRECISION='tf32' in fla/ops/gated_delta_rule/chunk_fwd.py:258-290. Pure IEEE-754 FP32 matches JAX Precision.HIGHEST to 3.1e-6 logits / 5.0e-7 loss, and production BF16 matches live Cloud TPU v5e to 6.19e-4 loss / 4.53e-4 step-10 loss.
